# @hiai-gg/dsh-docsmint
English | 简体中文

DocsMint in the DeepSeek Harness: a **left-sidebar panel** for your workspace and
**four agent tools

** the model can call, over either the DocsMint REST API or the
DocsMint MCP server.

- **DocsMint Cloud** (`docsmint.com`) — default. MCP mode authorizes through the
DocsMint OAuth flow

(dynamic client registration + PKCE); API mode uses an API
key.
- **Self-hosted DocsMint OSS** — se

cond option. API mode works today; MCP mode
targets an instance that serves `POST /mcp` (Streamable

HTTP) and authenticates
with that instance's API key.
> **Stable release: `1.0.0`.** Includes incremental document loading and the last successful refresh
able release: `1.0.0`.** Includes incremental document loading and the last successful refresh time.

Install a specific newer version in the same profile with the profile-scoped
`dsh plugin --profile w
eb add` command above. To remove it:

Removing the bundle does not delete DocsMint documents. Disconnect the plugin's
own authorization be

fore removal when needed; other integrations are unaffected.
To roll back, install the previous know
n-working version explicitly.
## Troubleshooting

- No sidebar entry: confirm the bundle is installed in the profile you launched,
inspect `--dump-con

fig`, and restart that profile.
- Cannot save credentials: enable the Harness credential store. The

panel does
not persist secrets in browser storage.
- Cloud OAuth fails: check the configured endpoin

lf-hosted connection fails: check the instance URL and key permissions.
MCP requires authenticated S

treamable HTTP at `POST /mcp`; use API mode if
your instance does not provide it.
- Unexpected docum

ents: verify workspace, category and folder, then reset filters.
- Report the package and Harness ve

rsions and a redacted error. Never include
API keys, OAuth tokens, or credential-store contents.
## What the panel does

- Connect DocsMint Cloud through OAuth (no API key), or connect either
deployment with an API key st

ored in the Harness credential store.
- Browse documents with **workspace / category / folder filter

s** and a
**sort** (updated, title, created), create categories, folders and documents
inline, and *

*edit a document's title and Markdown body** and save it.
- Open any document in the DocsMint web ap

p at
`/w/<workspace-slug>/documents/<id>`.
- Show which tools the agent has and which transport is a

/w/<workspace-slug>/documents/<id>`.
- Show which tools the agent has and which transport is active.

Category, folder and workspace filters and sorting are sent to the server before
pagination. Use SDK
2.1.0-compatible DocsMint endpoints for this behavior.
## Tools for the agent
| Tool | Purpose |

| `docsmint_search` | Hybrid search over the workspace; returns ids, titles, snippets, scores |
| `d

ocsmint_get_document` | Read one document with its Markdown body and a link |
| `docsmint_create_doc

ument` | Create a document, optionally inside a folder |
| `docsmint_update_document` | Update a doc
ument's title and/or Markdown body |

The tools use the same operations as the panel, so both stay consistent, and
they follow whatever tr
ansport the connection uses.
## Configuration
The Loader row accepts optional fields (all live in `config/cordis.patch.yml`):
| Field | Meaning |
| `baseUrl` | Pins the API base, e.g. `http://localhost:50700/api/v1`. Pinning disables the panel's

deployment choice. |
| `mode` | Pins `api` or `mcp` for every session. |
| `deployment` | Pins `clou

d` or `self-hosted` semantics. |
| `workspace` | Workspace slug used for `X-Docsmint-Workspace` and

for document links. |
| `apiKey` | Key from the patch instead of the credential store (CI and headle

links. |
| `apiKey` | Key from the patch instead of the credential store (CI and headless setups). |

Credentials live in the Harness credential store under `DOCSMINT_API_KEY`,
`DOCSMINT_WORKSPACE`, `DO

CSMINT_ENDPOINT`, `DOCSMINT_MODE` and `DOCSMINT_OAUTH`
(OAuth token record). Environment variables o

f the same names are honoured as a
fallback.
## Privacy

- The API key and OAuth tokens never reach page code; the panel talks to the
Host over a same-origin

route, and the Host talks to DocsMint.
- The plugin sends nothing anywhere except the DocsMint endp

oint you configure
(`docsmint.com` by default).
- No telemetry, no analytics, no third-party request

nt you configure
(`docsmint.com` by default).
- No telemetry, no analytics, no third-party requests.
## Compatibility

Built and tested against DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` (protocol `2025-06-18` for MCP) and
DocsMint MCP server `2

.0.4`, on Node 22. `engines` declares both bounds:
`node >=22` and `dsh >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0` — the u

pper bound is raised only after
the suite passes against the newer Harness. CI runs Node 22 and 24.

The client
half uses only the `slots` and `locale` client services and the `react` module
from the b
rowser module table.
## Brand

The sidebar entry draws the DocsMint mark from the brand asset itself: `dm` plus
the leaf, traced to

paths and simplified (mask overlap 0.991 against the trace,
~1.7 KB instead of ~4 KB of pixel steps

), so the letters follow `currentColor`
and read on both themes while the leaf keeps the brand mint

letters follow `currentColor`
and read on both themes while the leaf keeps the brand mint `#19B3A8`.

`assets/` carries the standalone variants — `docsmint-mark.svg` (dark ink),
`docsmint-mark-dark.svg`

(light ink) and `docsmint-mark-mono.svg`
(`currentColor`) — for documentation and for hosts that ne

ed a file instead of
inline SVG. The registered plugin icon (`icon.png`) is the DocsMint app tile as
served at `docsmint.com`, so it stays readable in both themes.
